components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold fill with ink label. The single primary action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { --tint: #80612A; --on-tint: #FFFFFF; background: var(--tint); color: var(--on-tint); width: 100%; padding: 15px 0; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.95; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); opacity: 0.9; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-btn-primary { --tint: #D8B477; --on-tint: #0A101A; } }

components.name: Card
components.description: The one card surface: flat fill, 1pt hairline, no glow.
components.css: .ds-card { --card: #FFFFFF; --text: #111B2B; --line: #E2DCD0; background: var(--card); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px; font-size: 17px; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 15px; opacity: 0.75; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-card { --card: #111B2B; --text: #E9E9E5; --line: #344258; } }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Borderless field inside a FormCard. Focus shows a gold wash.
components.css: .ds-input { --text: #111B2B; --wash: rgba(128,97,42,0.10); color: var(--text); background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 13px 16px; font-size: 15px; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { background: var(--wash); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-input { --text: #E9E9E5; --wash: rgba(216,180,119,0.12); } }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Semantic color as text on a 12% fill of itself.
components.css: .ds-chip { --c: 27,110,81; color: rgb(var(--c)); background: rgba(var(--c),0.12); padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-chip { --c: 66,184,148; } }

components.name: Overline
components.description: Monospaced uppercase kicker. The only uppercase in the product.
components.css: .ds-overline { color: #A07C3E; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-overline { color: #F0CA8A; } }

components.name: Pro Gate
components.description: Blurs gated content and shows one upgrade prompt for the whole group.

narrative.overview: Norviq is an instrument for reading your own money, not a feed. The identity is Precision Intelligence: obsidian and midnight navy in dark, warm paper in light, with one metal, gold, used sparingly. The interface represents discipline and the data represents reality, so nothing decorative is allowed to compete with a number.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered surfaces; depth comes from three tonal steps, not shadow.
One accent metal on about 10% of a screen.
Financial color is a separate vocabulary from brand color.
System controls and SF type; Dynamic Type everywhere.
Legible and correct with motion and effects off.

rules.name: The Gold Is Not Money Rule
rules.body: Gold never means profit. It marks the primary action, selection and focus, on about 10% of a screen. Not every card, not every border.

rules.name: The Never Color Alone Rule
rules.body: Gain and loss always travel with a sign, an arrow or a spoken label. Raw .green and .red are forbidden; make check-pnl-colors fails the build on them.

rules.name: The Twelve Percent Chip Rule
rules.body: A status or direction chip is the semantic color as text on a 12% fill of itself. That is the pair the identity spec measured at 4.5:1 or better.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that can sit next to another number uses tabular digits: .monospacedDigit() or a numeric Typography role.

rules.name: The Steps You Can See Rule
rules.body: The ladder is 17 / 15 / 13 / 12 / 11. Do not add a size between two steps; a 1pt difference is not hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Card Rule
rules.body: Card-shaped surfaces go through GlassCard. Feature code does not call .appGlassEffect(), stack its own material, or add a shadow.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No glow, no colored shadow, no gradient wash, no rim highlight.

dos: Do take every color from AppTheme.Colors, which resolves the Vigil* Color Sets.
Do use AppMotion tokens with .appAnimation(_:value:) and AppTransition.
Do put numbers in tabular digits and pair every gain or loss with a sign, arrow or label.
Do route user-facing text through the String Catalog.
Do say plainly what the app does with money and data.
donts: Don't use gold as profit, or green and red as decoration.
Don't add glow, mesh gradients, neon, decorative circuitry or "AI" sparkle.
Don't gamify trading: no confetti on a buy, no streaks, no green fireworks, no urgency.
Don't build the default SwiftUI tutorial stack: identical shadowed cards, or a hero metric with a gradient accent.
Don't show invented prices, balances or tickers anywhere, including illustrations.
Don't use Color(red:green:blue:), hex literals, raw .green / .red, or Color.white / Color.black for surfaces.
Don't use em dashes or exclamation marks in copy, and don't promise returns.
Don't animate a changing value in a table.
Don't place Vig next to a gain or a loss, or have Vig react to a trade.
Don't call .appGlassEffect() or .ultraThinMaterial from feature code for a card, and never use a material as a page background.
